title: Madden NFL 08 Sony PlayStation 2 2007 PS2 - CIB, Very Good
descriptionText:
Get ready to experience the thrill of American Football with Madden NFL 08 for Sony PlayStation 2. This game is perfect for gamers of all ages with its E-Everyone rating. Join the Madden NFL Series and compete with other players in this exciting multiplayer game. 

This complete in box (CIB) game by EA Sports includes everything you need to start playing right away. The game is region locked to NTSC-U/C (US/Canada) and was released in 2008. Don't miss out on the chance to add this classic sports game to your collection.
